Toughpower i1650W is an 80 PLUS Titanium certified digital PSU, fully compatible with ATX 3.1 specifications and built for high-performance workstations supporting up to 1650W and four native PCIe 12V-2x6 connectors.
It offers real-time power monitoring via TT RGB PLUS software and switchable single/multi-rail mode for ultimate stability and control.

Smart Digital Control
Built on a powerful digital platform, the Toughpower i1650W lets you monitor wattage, voltage, efficiency, and temperature
in real time via the TT RGB PLUS software on desktop or mobile.
Stay in control. Stay protected.
Smarter Control, Safer Power.
With real-time monitoring, single/ multi rail mode switching, and Smart Zero Fan control via
TT RGB PLUS software, you gain full command over performance, efficiency, and protection.
Smart Monitoring, Flexible Protection
Monitor power usage in real time for PCI-E, CPU, and 12V-2x6 outputs via software, while switching between single and multi rail modes to optimize protection for overclocking or multi GPU setups.
ATX 3.1 Ready
Toughpower i1650W is fully compatible with Intel ATX 3.1
specifications, supporting up to 200% power excursion,
reaching 60% efficiency at low load, and meeting all
required power supply timing standards.

PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready
Toughpower i1650W comes with native 12V-2x6 (16 pin) connectors to
deliver powerful and stable performance, allowing the PSU to support nextgeneration
GPUs.
The wattage marked on the 12V-2x6 connector follows Intel's recommended
design guideline. With four native 16 pin (12V-2x6) PCIe connectors, the
i1650W can support multiple high-wattage PCIe 5.1 graphics cards
simultaneously.
Note:
1. Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many other factors.
2. Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the PCIe 12V-2x6 cable.

High Amperage Single +12V Rail & High-Class Technologies
Powerful single +12V rail can deliver the power you need for the best compatibility. The use of LLC and DC to DC circuit design provides extremely stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.
